description: This file defines the ServiceOperations class, which provides static utility methods for managing the lifecycle of services in the Apache Hive project, including initialization, starting, stopping, and state verification.

classes.name: ServiceOperations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to manage service lifecycle states in Apache Hive.

methods.name: ensureCurrentState
methods.description: Verifies that a service is in the expected state; throws IllegalStateException if not.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a service after verifying it is in the NOTINITED state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a service after verifying it is in the INITED state.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Initializes and then starts a service.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops a service if it is in the STARTED state.

methods.name: stopQuietly
methods.description: Stops a service quietly, catching and logging exceptions.
